instruction: You should walk past the bar and to the pool. Across from the pool there is a doorway, go through that doorway and wait.

steps.thought: I see the pool ahead past the seating. I'll advance toward it, then look for the doorway across from the pool.
I'm facing the pool area with chairs and a table in front. I need to move toward the pool, then find the doorway across from it.
I'm at the pool area now. I need to find the doorway across from the pool; I'll scan right to locate it.
I'm at the pool area; the lit doorway across the pool is on the right side. I'll turn right and move toward it.
I'm at the pool area; a lit doorway is visible ahead past the pool. I'll advance toward it, re-checking alignment.
I'm at the pool area and can see a lit doorway across from the pool ahead. I'll advance toward it, re-observing before entering.
I'm at the pool; the doorway across from it is visible ahead, slightly right of center. I'll advance toward it and re-check alignment.
I'm at the pool and can see the doorway across from it, slightly ahead-right. I'll advance toward it and re-aim before entering.
I'm at the pool; the doorway across the pool is visible ahead slightly right. I'll advance toward it and re-observe.
I'm at the pool and can see the doorway across from it, slightly to the right. I'll turn right to align with it and move forward.
The pool is on my left and the doorway across from it is visible ahead, slightly right of center. I'll advance toward it and re-aim as I get closer.
The doorway across from the pool is visible ahead, slightly right of center. I'll advance toward it and re-observe before entering.
The doorway across from the pool is directly ahead, slightly right of center. I'll advance toward it and then stop once through.
The doorway across from the pool is directly ahead and close; I'll advance toward it and stop inside.
I'm at the beaded doorway across from the pool; I need to pass through it and wait just inside.
